description: Compose the existing rope cinch, canonical Dome railing, real brown sack, and authored short vertical geography into reversible cargo-line utility without a recipe matrix or parallel physics engine

replacements.new:
<ROUTINE MATERIAL-FIXED-ROPE-ANCHOR? ()
	<COND (<AND ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR
	            <NOT <EQUAL? ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR ,SANDWICH-BAG>>>
	       <RTRUE>)>
	<RFALSE>>

<ROUTINE UTILITY-MESH-CARGO-TIED? ()
    <COND (<AND <EQUAL? ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR ,SANDWICH-BAG>
                ,MATERIAL-SACK-CINCHED
                <NOT <FSET? ,SANDWICH-BAG ,RMUNGBIT>>>
           <RTRUE>)>
    <RFALSE>>

<ROUTINE UTILITY-MESH-ROPE-CONTROLLED? ()
    <COND (<IN? ,ROPE ,WINNER> <RTRUE>)
          (<AND ,DOME-FLAG
                <EQUAL? ,HERE ,DOME-ROOM>
                <EQUAL? <LOC ,ROPE> ,DOME-ROOM>>
           <RTRUE>)>
    <RFALSE>>

<ROUTINE UTILITY-MESH-LOWER-ROOM ()
    <COND (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,KITCHEN> ,STUDIO)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,UP-A-TREE> ,PATH)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,GRATING-CLEARING>
           <COND (<AND ,GRATE-REVEALED <FSET? ,GRATE ,OPENBIT>> ,GRATING-ROOM)
                 (T <RFALSE>)>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,DOME-ROOM>
           <COND (,DOME-FLAG ,TORCH-ROOM)
                 (T <RFALSE>)>)
          (T <RFALSE>)>>

<ROUTINE UTILITY-MESH-CARGO-RETURN-ACTION? ()
    <COND (<AND <EQUAL? ,HERE ,UP-A-TREE>
                <EQUAL? <LOC ,SANDWICH-BAG> ,PATH>
                <OR <AND <VERB? WALK> <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,P?DOWN>>
                    <VERB? CLIMB-DOWN>>>
           <RTRUE>)
          (<AND <EQUAL? ,HERE ,GRATING-CLEARING>
                <EQUAL? <LOC ,SANDWICH-BAG> ,GRATING-ROOM>
                <AND <VERB? WALK> <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,P?DOWN>>>
           <RTRUE>)
          (<AND <EQUAL? ,HERE ,DOME-ROOM>
                <EQUAL? <LOC ,SANDWICH-BAG> ,TORCH-ROOM>
                ,DOME-FLAG
                <AND <VERB? WALK> <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,P?DOWN>>>
           <RTRUE>)>
    <RFALSE>>

<ROUTINE UTILITY-MESH-CARGO-SPAN-BLOCK? ()
    <COND (<AND <UTILITY-MESH-CARGO-TIED?>
                <IN? ,ROPE ,WINNER>
                <NOT <ACCESSIBLE? ,SANDWICH-BAG>>
                <VERB? WALK WALK-TO WALK-AROUND THROUGH ENTER EXIT
                       CLIMB-UP CLIMB-DOWN CLIMB-FOO LEAP>>
           <COND (<UTILITY-MESH-CARGO-RETURN-ACTION?> <RFALSE>)
                 (T
                  <TELL "The rope draws taut toward the brown sack at the other end of the vertical run. You can haul the sack, or return along the line; wandering away would require more rope than you have." CR>
                  <RTRUE>)>)>
    <RFALSE>>

<ROUTINE UTILITY-MESH-LOWER-SACK ("AUX" DEST)
    <COND (<NOT <UTILITY-MESH-CARGO-TIED?>>
           <TELL "The brown sack has no line attached. Tie the rope to it first." CR>)
          (<NOT <UTILITY-MESH-ROPE-CONTROLLED?>>
           <TELL "The sack is tied to the rope, but the useful end of the line is not under your control here." CR>)
          (<NOT <ACCESSIBLE? ,SANDWICH-BAG>>
           <TELL "The brown sack is already at the far end of the rope." CR>)
          (<AND <EQUAL? ,HERE ,GRATING-CLEARING>
                <NOT ,GRATE-REVEALED>>
           <TELL "There is no exposed opening here through which to lower the sack." CR>)
          (<AND <EQUAL? ,HERE ,GRATING-CLEARING>
                <NOT <FSET? ,GRATE ,OPENBIT>>>
           <TELL "The closed grating leaves no opening for the sack." CR>)
          (<AND <EQUAL? ,HERE ,DOME-ROOM> <NOT ,DOME-FLAG>>
           <TELL "That drop is too exposed to trust to your grip alone. The railing is the obvious anchor if you mean to use the rope here." CR>)
          (<NOT <SET DEST <UTILITY-MESH-LOWER-ROOM>>>
           <TELL "Rope and sack are useful together, but this room supplies no short vertical freight route for them." CR>)
          (T
           <MOVE ,SANDWICH-BAG .DEST>
           <COND (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,KITCHEN>
                  <TELL "You pay out rope through the chimney. The brown sack noses into the flue, slides out of sight, and settles in the Studio below while the free line stays under your control." CR>)
                 (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,UP-A-TREE>
                  <TELL "You ease the brown sack over the branch and lower it to the forest path ten feet below. The rope turns an awkward climb into a controlled cargo drop." CR>)
                 (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,GRATING-CLEARING>
                  <TELL "You feed the brown sack through the open grating and lower it into the chamber below instead of simply dropping it into darkness." CR>)
                 (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,DOME-ROOM>
                  <TELL "With the other end secured at the railing, you lower the brown sack over the dome's edge until it reaches the Torch Room below." CR>)>
           <RTRUE>)>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE UTILITY-MESH-HAUL-SACK ("AUX" SOURCE)
    <COND (<NOT <UTILITY-MESH-CARGO-TIED?>> <RFALSE>)
          (<NOT <UTILITY-MESH-ROPE-CONTROLLED?>>
           <TELL "You do not have control of the free rope here." CR>
           <RTRUE>)
          (<ACCESSIBLE? ,SANDWICH-BAG>
           <TELL "The brown sack is already at your end of the rope." CR>
           <RTRUE>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,KITCHEN> <SET SOURCE ,STUDIO>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,UP-A-TREE> <SET SOURCE ,PATH>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,GRATING-CLEARING>
           <COND (<AND ,GRATE-REVEALED <FSET? ,GRATE ,OPENBIT>>
                  <SET SOURCE ,GRATING-ROOM>)
                 (T
                  <TELL "The grating is not open around the line, so hauling now would only jam the sack against iron." CR>
                  <RTRUE>)>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,DOME-ROOM>
           <COND (,DOME-FLAG <SET SOURCE ,TORCH-ROOM>)
                 (T
                  <TELL "Without the railing knot there is no secure upper end from which to haul." CR>
                  <RTRUE>)>)
          (T
           <TELL "The rope leads away, but not along a vertical freight route you can work from here." CR>
           <RTRUE>)>
    <COND (<NOT <EQUAL? <LOC ,SANDWICH-BAG> .SOURCE>>
           <TELL "The rope is committed to the sack, but the sack is not at the other end of this particular drop." CR>
           <RTRUE>)>
    <MOVE ,SANDWICH-BAG ,HERE>
    <COND (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,KITCHEN>
           <TELL "Hand over hand, you haul the brown sack up the chimney. It bumps through the narrow flue and arrives in the Kitchen without ever becoming another package on your body." CR>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,UP-A-TREE>
           <TELL "You haul steadily on the rope until the brown sack rises from the path and swings within reach among the branches." CR>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,GRATING-CLEARING>
           <TELL "The rope tightens, the brown sack rises through the open grating, and the forest floor becomes a freight destination instead of a one-way exit." CR>)
          (<EQUAL? ,HERE ,DOME-ROOM>
           <TELL "Braced by the railing knot, you haul the brown sack back up from the Torch Room and over the dome's edge." CR>)>
    <RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE MATERIAL-UNTIE-ROPE ()
	<COND (<NOT ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR> <RFALSE>)
	      (<NOT <OR <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,ROPE>
	                <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR>>>
	       <RFALSE>)>
	<TELL "You undo the knot around the " D ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR ". The rope is fully available again." CR>
	<SETG MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR <>>
	<SETG MATERIAL-SACK-CINCHED <>>
	<RTRUE>>
replacements.new:
<ROUTINE MATERIAL-UNTIE-ROPE ()
	<COND (<NOT ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR> <RFALSE>)
	      (<NOT <OR <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,ROPE>
	                <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR>>>
	       <RFALSE>)
	      (<AND ,DOME-FLAG
	            <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,ROPE>
	            <EQUAL? ,PRSI ,RAILING>>
	       <RFALSE>)
	      (<AND ,DOME-FLAG
	            <UTILITY-MESH-CARGO-TIED?>
	            <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,ROPE>
	            <NOT ,PRSI>>
	       <TELL "Both ends are committed: the rope is cinched to the brown sack and tied to the railing. Specify which knot you mean to undo." CR>
	       <RTRUE>)
	      (<AND <EQUAL? ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR ,SANDWICH-BAG>
	            <NOT <ACCESSIBLE? ,SANDWICH-BAG>>>
	       <TELL "The knot is around the brown sack at the far end of the line. You cannot untie that knot from here." CR>
	       <RTRUE>)>
	<TELL "You undo the knot around the " D ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR ". The rope is fully available again." CR>
	<SETG MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR <>>
	<SETG MATERIAL-SACK-CINCHED <>>
	<RTRUE>>

<ROUTINE MATERIAL-ROPE-HOOK ()
	<COND (<AND <VERB? SHADOW-USE-ON TIE> <MATERIAL-ROPE-USE-ON>>
	       <RTRUE>)
	      (<AND <VERB? UNTIE> <MATERIAL-UNTIE-ROPE>>
	       <RTRUE>)
	      (<AND ,MATERIAL-SACK-CINCHED
	            <VERB? OPEN>
	            <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,SANDWICH-BAG>>
	       <TELL "The rope is cinched around the sack's mouth. Untie the sack before trying to open it." CR>
	       <RTRUE>)
	      (<AND ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR
	            <VERB? DROP GIVE>
	            <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,ROPE>>
	       <TELL "The rope cannot be surrendered while one end remains tied to the " D ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR "." CR>
	       <RTRUE>)
	      (<AND ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR
	            <VERB? EXAMINE>
	            <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,ROPE>>
	       <TELL "The rope is sound. One end is tied to the " D ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR ", while the remaining coil is still under your control." CR>
	       <RTRUE>)
	      (<AND ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR
	            <VERB? MOVE>
	            <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,ROPE>>
	       <TELL "The rope draws taut against the " D ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR ". The knot holds." CR>
	       <RTRUE>)
	      (<AND <MATERIAL-FIXED-ROPE-ANCHOR?>
	            <ACCESSIBLE? ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR>
	            <VERB? WALK WALK-TO WALK-AROUND THROUGH ENTER EXIT
	                   CLIMB-UP CLIMB-DOWN CLIMB-FOO LEAP>>
	       <TELL "The anchored rope reaches its useful limit and checks your movement. Untie it or remain on this side of the experiment." CR>
	       <RTRUE>)>
	<RFALSE>>

<ROUTINE MATERIAL-ROPE-HOOK ()
	<COND (<AND <VERB? TIE>
	            <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,SANDWICH-BAG>
	            <EQUAL? ,PRSI ,ROPE>>
	       <SHADOW-PERFORM ,V?TIE ,ROPE ,SANDWICH-BAG>
	       <RTRUE>)
	      (<AND <VERB? SHADOW-USE-ON TIE> <MATERIAL-ROPE-USE-ON>>
	       <RTRUE>)
	      (<AND <VERB? UNTIE> <MATERIAL-UNTIE-ROPE>>
	       <RTRUE>)
	      (<AND ,MATERIAL-SACK-CINCHED
	            <VERB? OPEN>
	            <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,SANDWICH-BAG>>
	       <TELL "The rope is cinched around the sack's mouth. Untie the sack before trying to open it." CR>
	       <RTRUE>)
	      (<AND ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR
	            <VERB? DROP GIVE>
	            <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,ROPE>>
	       <TELL "The rope cannot be surrendered while one end remains tied to the " D ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR "." CR>
	       <RTRUE>)
	      (<AND <UTILITY-MESH-CARGO-TIED?>
	            <VERB? LOWER>
	            <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,SANDWICH-BAG ,ROPE>>
	       <UTILITY-MESH-LOWER-SACK>
	       <RTRUE>)
	      (<AND <UTILITY-MESH-CARGO-TIED?>
	            <VERB? MOVE RAISE>
	            <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,ROPE>>
	       <UTILITY-MESH-HAUL-SACK>
	       <RTRUE>)
	      (<UTILITY-MESH-CARGO-SPAN-BLOCK?> <RTRUE>)
	      (<AND ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR
	            <VERB? EXAMINE>
	            <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,ROPE>>
	       <COND (<AND <UTILITY-MESH-CARGO-TIED?> ,DOME-FLAG>
	              <TELL "The rope is doing two honest jobs at once: one end is cinched to the brown sack and the other is secured to the Dome Room railing." CR>)
	             (T
	              <TELL "The rope is sound. One end is tied to the " D ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR ", while the remaining coil is still under your control." CR>)>
	       <RTRUE>)
	      (<AND ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR
	            <VERB? MOVE>
	            <EQUAL? ,PRSO ,ROPE>>
	       <TELL "The rope draws taut against the " D ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR ". The knot holds." CR>
	       <RTRUE>)
	      (<AND <MATERIAL-FIXED-ROPE-ANCHOR?>
	            <ACCESSIBLE? ,MATERIAL-ROPE-ANCHOR>
	            <VERB? WALK WALK-TO WALK-AROUND THROUGH ENTER EXIT
	                   CLIMB-UP CLIMB-DOWN CLIMB-FOO LEAP>>
	       <TELL "The anchored rope reaches its useful limit and checks your movement. Untie it or remain on this side of the experiment." CR>
	       <RTRUE>)>
	<RFALSE>>
